eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Chelan, WA; at 5:42 AM on AUG 22, 2024 Effective until 7:42 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Chelan County Sheriff's Office has issued a Level 1 Fire Advisory for Cashmere area.  The area affected is Nahahum Canyon Road.
Chelan County Sheriff's Office has issued a Level 1 Fire Advisory for Cashmere area.  The area affected is Nahahum Canyon Road. You will be kept advised as conditions change.  Please monitor local radio stations and Chelan County Emergency Management Facebook for updates.
